content.summary: Implemented Build the file list sidebar for the Changes route

validation_results.tests: not run (not required by acceptance criteria)
validation_results.lint: not run (not required by acceptance criteria)

acceptance_criteria_status.criterion: Component calls sdk.client.file.status() to fetch file data on mount (and provides a refresh mechanism)
Files are grouped by section headers: Staged, Unstaged, Untracked
Within each stage section, files are displayed in directory-grouped tree/list form (directory headers + child files)
Each file row shows relative file path (truncated if needed), +N in green, -N in red
Arrow keys (up/down) navigate between files; Enter or click selects a file
The currently selected file is visually highlighted (background color change)
Empty state: when no files are changed, show No changes message
The Changes index component integrates FileList in a left panel (fixed width ~35-40 chars)
Selected file ID/path is lifted to parent via a signal/callback so the diff pane can react
If a file exists in both staged and unstaged sets, both entries are visible and distinguishable in the sidebar

data.notes: Implemented stage-aware sidebar with directory headers, keyboard/mouse selection, and refresh affordance. Added stage fallback logic for SDKs without stage typing by defaulting missing stage to unstaged.
